description: Apollo.io is a sales intelligence and engagement platform for searching and enriching company and contact data and managing go-to-market workflows. It also provides tools for CRM records, sequences, conversations, calls, tasks, and analytics.
summary: Apollo.io exposes a REST API at `https://api.apollo.io/api/v1`, a remote MCP server at `https://mcp.apollo.io/mcp`, and an `apollo` CLI; the API supports Apollo API keys or partner OAuth, while MCP and CLI use OAuth.
